verdicts.evidence: Counting cells from the 09:00 tick, the 10:00 column is the 25–29 shade every weekday, while the 11:00 column is the darkest 30+ shade on Mon and Fri and 25–29 on Tue–Thu, so it is at least as busy every day, yet the stat panel says 'Busiest hour, weekdays 10:00'.
There is a tick only every three hours (00:00, 03:00 … 21:00), each left-aligned at the start of a cell, and nothing says whether a label names the cell or the line before it.
